jobs_results.description:
Introduction

At IBM Research, we are the innovation engine of IBM. Exploring what’s next in computing and shaping the technologies the world will rely on tomorrow. From advancing AI and hybrid cloud to pioneering practical quantum computing, we anticipate challenges and unlock new opportunities for clients, partners, and society. Working in Research means j oining a team that accelerates discovery at the intersection of high-performance computing, AI, quantum, and cloud. You’ll collaborate with leading scientists, engineers, and visionaries to push boundaries and turn ideas into reality. With a culture built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration, IBM Research offers the opportunity to grow your career while contributing to breakthroughs that transform industries and change the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an intern in the Quantum Information Software group at IBM, you will work closely with researchers and developers to advance the state of the art in software for fault tolerant quantum computing. Your role can include:

Resource estimation of quantum algorithmsCompilation and optimization of high-level quantum algorithm primitives such as block encoding and arithmeticDeveloping techniques to reduce the non-Clifford resource usage of specific quantum algorithms Optimizing compilation for the bicycle architecture, including magic state factories and entanglement routingPerform an implementation of existing optimization techniques from the literature

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Familiarity with quantum information and quantum circuits.Ability to transform theoretical concepts to software prototypes.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Track record of independent research and publication in quantum information science.Familiarity with modern quantum algorithms for simulation and cryptography.Expertise in quantum architectures based on qLDPC codes.Familiarity with error correction and simulations of QEC circuits.Familiarity with early fault tolerant quantum computing literature.

jobs_results.job_title: Senior Software Engineer — Quantum Platform & Tools
jobs_results.description:
D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It is the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the first and only to offer dual-platform quantum computing products and services, spanning both annealing and gate-model quantum computing technologies. D-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise-grade systems available on-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations across commercial, government, and research sectors trust D-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D-Wave is shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: www.dwavequantum.com.

About the role

D-Wave is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Systems Software Engineering team. In this role, you will design and build core platform infrastructure, backend services, and user-facing features that enable seamless access and reliable operation of our simulators and gate-model quantum computers. You will have the opportunity to help shape our products, contributing to highly visible, impactful projects that advance the future of quantum computing. We are looking for an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building automated, scalable, resilient systems. You are thoughtful about engineering tradeoffs, passionate about delivering high-quality software, and motivated to raise technical standards through design leadership, mentorship, and collaboration.

jobs_results.job_title: Software Development Engineer II, Centre for Quantum Computing
jobs_results.description:
DESCRIPTION
 
  The Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is hiring a Software Development Engineer to build AI-native systems that accelerate quantum device research and fabrication. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and experimental science, building workflows and data infrastructure that connect scientists, hardware engineers, and AI models into a tightly integrated development loop. 
  

  

   Key job responsibilities 
  

  
   Design and build data lakes and pipelines that unify experimental, fabrication, and metrology data from heterogeneous sources into a single, queryable platform for scientists and engineers
  
  

  
   Develop AI-native workflows that automate the experiment-analysis-recommendation cycle: ingest results, run ML models, surface insights, and propose next steps with minimal human intervention
  
  

  
   Build LLM-powered tools and autonomous agents that allow researchers to query, visualize, and reason over fabrication and experimental data using natural language
  
  

  
   Partner directly with research scientists, process engineers, and hardware teams to understand their problems deeply and translate research needs into working software
  
  

  
   Implement ML-driven analysis systems (e.g., automated defect detection, yield prediction, process optimization) that operate on live fabrication data
  
  

  
   Design and build recommendation engines that evaluate design-of-experiment tradeoffs (cost, time, performance) and surface actionable suggestions to research teams
  
  

  
   Own the reliability, scalability, and operational health of the systems you build, including monitoring, alerting, and on-call support
  
  

  
   Contribute to the technical direction of the Device Lifecycle team through design documents, architecture reviews, and code reviews
  
  

   About the team 
  

   You will be joining the Device Lifecycle software development team within the AWS Center for Quantum Computing. Our team builds the software that enables scaling up quantum computing technologies, from fabrication execution systems to AI-powered research tools. We are a small, high-impact team where every engineer's work directly shapes the pace of quantum device development.
 
  BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
 
  3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  3+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
  Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
  Experience programming with at least one software programming language
 
  PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
 
  4+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  Master's degree in computer science or equivalent
  Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques
  Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
  Experience with research and investigation skills or equivalent
  Experience in semiconductor fabrication, foundry operations, or cleanroom environments

jobs_results.description:
Introduction

At IBM Research, we are the innovation engine of IBM. Exploring what’s next in computing and shaping the technologies the world will rely on tomorrow. From advancing AI and hybrid cloud to pioneering practical quantum computing, we anticipate challenges and unlock new opportunities for clients, partners, and society. Working in Research means j oining a team that accelerates discovery at the intersection of high-performance computing, AI, quantum, and cloud. You’ll collaborate with leading scientists, engineers, and visionaries to push boundaries and turn ideas into reality. With a culture built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration, IBM Research offers the opportunity to grow your career while contributing to breakthroughs that transform industries and change the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an intern in the Quantum Information Software group at IBM, you will work closely with researchers and developers to advance the state of the art in software for fault tolerant quantum computing. Your role can include:

Resource estimation of quantum algorithmsCompilation and optimization of high-level quantum algorithm primitives such as block encoding and arithmeticDeveloping techniques to reduce the non-Clifford resource usage of specific quantum algorithms Optimizing compilation for the bicycle architecture, including magic state factories and entanglement routingPerform an implementation of existing optimization techniques from the literature

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Familiarity with quantum information and quantum circuits.Ability to transform theoretical concepts to software prototypes.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Track record of independent research and publication in quantum information science.Familiarity with modern quantum algorithms for simulation and cryptography.Expertise in quantum architectures based on qLDPC codes.Familiarity with error correction and simulations of QEC circuits.Familiarity with early fault tolerant quantum computing literature.
